question: What further instruction is promised after the triple path has been declared?
premises: The triple path has already been declared.
The naked remains as a topic to be explained.
The speaker addresses the listener with a promise to tell.
inference: After declaring the triple path, the speaker will now explain the naked to the listener.
uncertainties: The doctrinal meaning of nagnaṃ (naked) in this context is not specified in the verse.
plain_english: But the triple path has been declared; now I will tell you about the naked.
